info.title: Sydecrew API
info.description: Generated from the backend zod schemas (src/contract). Money is integer paise. Errors: { error: { code, message, details } }.

code.description: Stable machine code; see ErrorCode and contracts/errors.json

headers.description: Send these headers with a PUT upload

fields.description: Form fields for an S3 POST upload; the file goes last as "file"

status.description: New status, or PENDING_SECOND_APPROVAL (HTTP 202) when a second approver must agree

post.summary: Approve or reject a second-approver request

patch.summary: Change a category price band (pauses rates outside it)

post.summary: Propose lifting a suspension (second approver)
Send a companion to re-verification (risk)
Suspend a companion
Approve or reject a pending edit
Clear or confirm a flag (clearing a banned match needs a second approver)

get.summary: Application detail: checks, OCR diff, flags, photos, history, permissions

post.summary: Claim an application (30-min lease, exclusive)
Approve / needs changes / reject (202 when a second approver is needed)

get.summary: Signed document URL (<= 60 s, logged; TOTP within 15 min)

post.summary: Add a manual flag
Release your claim
Propose reopening an auto-rejected attempt (second approver)
Send the email verification link again
Verify an email link token
Log in step 1: password; then an OTP challenge, or a TOTP step for enrolled staff
End the session

get.summary: The signed-in user, onboarding / companion next step, staff MFA state

post.summary: Staff login step 2: TOTP or recovery code
Replace the recovery codes (needs a TOTP check within 15 min)
Confirm the first TOTP code; returns 10 recovery codes once
Start TOTP enrolment (staff)
Step-up: a fresh TOTP check on this session
Resend the newest one-time code
Verify a one-time code and start a session
Email a password reset link (same answer whether or not the email exists)
Set a new password with a reset token; unlocks and signs out everywhere
Rotate the refresh token (cookie on web, body on mobile)
Sign up: name, email, Indian mobile, password; texts a code

put.summary: Choose activities (must belong to chosen categories)

post.summary: Become a companion: consents, DOB / zone if missing; creates a DRAFT profile (idempotent)

get.summary: Weekly slots, exceptions and booking settings (IST)

put.summary: Replace weekly slots (no overlaps) and booking settings

post.summary: Block a date or add an extra slot

put.summary: Catalog boundaries plus up to 3 moderated custom ones

post.summary: Go live once setup is complete (idempotent)

get.summary: The companion profile, checklist, verification attempt and next step
Categories (price bands, activities), boundaries, languages, pilot zones, document types, limits

post.summary: Pause a live profile
Confirm an uploaded photo (checked, EXIF stripped, resized)

put.summary: Reorder photos; the first is the main photo

post.summary: Start or resume a photo upload (URL bound to type and size)

patch.summary: Display name, intro, languages, zone, radius (approved fields go to moderation when live)

get.summary: Rates per offering with the allowed price band

post.summary: Resume a paused profile
Submit the application for checks and review (idempotent)
Start or update the identity attempt (document type)

Complete customer onboarding (18+, city, interests, consents)

This OpenAPI document (not served in production)
